title: Odd-parity surface magnetism in a Kondo insulator
summary: We formulate a theory of spin-polarized tunneling between a nanowire tip of a topological Kondo insulator SmB$_6$ and the bi-collinear antiferromagnet Fe$_{1+x}$Te in which the tunneling conductance which measures magnetic contrast changes sign when the bias is reversed. First we show that no time reversal symmetric tip, however strong its spin-momentum locking is, can produce experimentally observed magnetic contrast, which implies that time reversal must be broken at the tip surface. Within a mean-field treatment of the surface theory of SmB$_6$ we find that the interaction between conduction d-and f-electrons drives a surface phase transition near T$_c$ ~10 K in which the time reversal odd component of the Kondo hybridization amplitude condenses in the same symmetry channel as an out-of-plane surface magnetization, gapping out the Dirac surface states. Below the transition the spin-resolved spectral function of each gapped surface Dirac cone is odd in energy about its node. For a charge-neutral apex the Fermi level lies between the surface $Γ$ and $X$ Dirac nodes, so the spin-polarized conductance, which is determined by this function at the bias energy, reverses its sign close to zero bias. This sign change is thus a spectroscopic signature of time reversal symmetry breaking on the surface of SmB6.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑近藤绝缘体SmB6纳米线针尖与Fe1+xTe之间自旋极化隧穿的理论，指出时间反演对称性在针尖表面被破坏，导致隧穿电导的磁衬度在偏压反转时改变符号。
AI.motivation: 实验观察到SmB6针尖与Fe1+xTe间的磁衬度会随偏压反向而变号，需要理论解释，尤其要说明时间反演对称针尖（即使自旋-动量锁定很强）为何无法产生该磁衬度。
AI.method: 对SmB6表面理论做平均场处理，研究传导d电子与f电子相互作用，考察近藤杂化振幅中时间反演奇分量与面外表面磁化在同一对称通道的凝聚及其对狄拉克表面态的能隙化影响，并计算自旋分辨谱函数与自旋极化电导。
AI.result: 相互作用驱动约Tc~10 K的表面相变，时间反演奇分量凝聚并打开狄拉克表面态能隙；相变后各能隙化狄拉克锥的自旋分辨谱函数关于节点在能量上呈奇函数。中性针尖费米能级位于表面Γ与X狄拉克节点之间，故自旋极化电导在零偏压附近改变符号。
AI.conclusion: 零偏压附近电导的符号改变是SmB6表面时间反演对称性破缺的光谱学特征。

title: Search for free non-Abelian anyons in paired composite-fermion states
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures in the main text, 6 figures in the supplementary material
summary: The even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states, understood as topological superconductors of composite fermions, are predicted to support elementary quasiparticles (QPs) or quasiholes (QHs) obeying non-Abelian braid statistics. Using the microscopic framework of parton theory, we investigate many experimentally observed paired composite-fermion states and find that their elementary QPs and QHs in general bind to form Abelian molecules, thus obscuring non-Abelian braid statistics. An exception is the $ν=1/2$ state in wide quantum wells, where our calculations show free QPs or QHs; we thus identify this state as an especially promising candidate for realizing and studying non-Abelian braid statistics. We also indicate how the study of such bound states can help reveal the topological structure of the state.

AI.tldr: 本文用parton理论研究了实验观测到的配对复合费米子态，发现其基本准粒子/准空穴通常结合成阿贝尔分子，掩盖了非阿贝尔编织统计；宽量子阱中的ν=1/2态是例外，存在自由准粒子，是有望研究非阿贝尔统计的候选态。
AI.motivation: 偶数分母分数量子霍尔态被认为是复合费米子的拓扑超导体，预测具有服从非阿贝尔编织统计的准粒子，但实验上观测到的配对复合费米子态是否真正展现这种统计尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用parton理论的微观框架，对多个实验观测到的配对复合费米子态中的基本准粒子和准空穴进行研究。
AI.result: 发现这些态的基本准粒子和准空穴通常结合成阿贝尔分子，从而掩盖非阿贝尔编织统计；宽量子阱中的ν=1/2态例外，计算显示存在自由的准粒子或准空穴。
AI.conclusion: 宽量子阱中的ν=1/2态是实现和研究中心非阿贝尔编织统计的特别有希望的候选态；对这类束缚态的研究有助于揭示该态的拓扑结构。

title: Improving the lower bound on the Laughlin gap: An SDP search
summary: A recent preprint by OpenAI resolved the spherical fermionic Laughlin spectral-gap conjecture for the full $V_1$ interaction by a Fock-space inequality: $H_Q^2\ge γH_Q$ on the lowest-Landau-level Fock space for all large flux $Q$ and every $γ$ below $0.0461673\ldots$, so that the gap above the Laughlin state at filling $1/3$ is at least $1/25$. That proof, with its original constant, has also been formalized in Lean. We show that the same argument supports a much larger constant. Two sharper estimates, a product-twirl bound for the three-body tail and a staircase price for the four-body allowance, raise the constant above $0.0601$ without changing the original certificate. Treating the auxiliary operators as the variables of a semidefinite program (SDP) and enlarging the finite set of orbital modes on which they act then gives $H_Q^2\geγH_Q$ for every $γ<γ_*=0.2190037845063196\ldots$, certified by exact rational arithmetic. Consequently the gap above the Laughlin state is at least $1/5$ for all sufficiently large spheres, and the untruncated planar $V_1$ Hamiltonian has positive spectrum bounded below by $γ_*$, uniformly in particle number and angular momentum. A heuristic extrapolation of the SDP optima suggests that auxiliary operators of the present form can give at most about $0.222$, while exact diagonalization of finite systems places the true gap near $0.4$. A larger family of auxiliary operators could push the bound further towards the true gap, and the SDP formulation makes such families easy to test. The proof of the improvement and the SDP search were completed by the AI model Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) under the author's direction.

AI.tldr: 该文改进OpenAI关于球面费米子Laughlin谱隙猜想的Fock空间不等式，通过更精细的三体/四体估计及SDP方法，将常数从0.046提升至γ*=0.219，从而证明Laughlin态上方谱隙至少为1/5。
AI.motivation: OpenAI此前用Fock空间不等式H_Q^2≥γH_Q证明了Laughlin谱隙下界（γ<0.0461673，隙≥1/25），但常数偏小。作者希望在不改变原证明证书的前提下，大幅提高该常数，逼近真实谱隙。
AI.method: 两项更精细的估计：三体尾项的产品-twirl界、四体允许量的阶梯代价，将常数提到0.0601以上；进一步将辅助算子视为半正定规划(SDP)变量并扩大其作用的有限轨道模式集，用精确有理算术认证，得到γ*=0.2190037845063196…。
AI.result: H_Q^2≥γH_Q对所有γ<γ*成立；Laughlin态上方谱隙在足够大球面上至少为1/5；未截断平面V_1哈密顿量谱正下界为γ*，且对粒子数和角动量一致成立。SDP最优值外推提示现有辅助算子形式最多约0.222，而有限系统精确对角化显示真实隙约0.4。
AI.conclusion: 更大的辅助算子族有望进一步逼近真实谱隙，SDP框架便于测试此类族。改进证明与SDP搜索由AI模型Claude Opus 5.5在作者指导下完成。

title: Homogeneous to multi-scale inhomogeneous complex magnetism in Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho), Revealed by muSR and Machine-Learned Muon-Site Calculations
summary: We report a comprehensive muon spin rotation and relaxation (muSR) study of the hexagonal 6H-perovskites Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho) to investigate the role of rare-earth anisotropy in the magnetic ground state of 4d-4f coupled systems. Ba3HoRu2O9 exhibits two successive magnetic orderings at TN1 = 46 K and TN2 = 10 K, leading to a complex magnetic ground state, whereas Ba3GdRu2O9, with Gd3+ (L = 0) S-state ions, shows primarily single magnetic ordering at TN = 14.5 K. Zero-field (ZF) and longitudinal-field (LF) muSR measurements reveal markedly different magnetic behavior despite their structural similarity. Ba3HoRu2O9 displays a multi-scale inhomogeneous magnetic state characterized by two-component exponential relaxation, broad local-field distributions, incomplete LF decoupling, and persistent spin dynamics. The muSR results identify two characteristic magnetic energy scales near 46 and 10 K, associated with correlated Ru-Ho interactions and quasistatic magnetic ordering, respectively. Redfield analysis further demonstrates strong local magnetic fields and distributed spin fluctuation timescales, confirming magnetic inhomogeneity. Machine-learning-assisted muon-site and dipolar-field calculations show that the broad field distribution naturally arises from muons sensing distinct coexisting magnetic domains at different structural sites. In contrast, Ba3GdRu2O9 exhibits a comparatively homogeneous antiferromagnetic ground state below 14.5 K, with Gaussian relaxation consistent with a narrow static field distribution. These results establish that the rare-earth ion in Ba3LnRu2O9 is a powerful tuning parameter, driving the ground state from homogeneous to complex, multi-scale inhomogeneous behavior through competing 4d-4f magnetic interactions.

AI.tldr: 通过μSR研究6H钙钛矿Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln=Gd, Ho)，揭示稀土各向异性对4d-4f耦合磁基态的调控作用。
AI.motivation: 探究稀土离子各向异性在4d-4f耦合体系磁基态中的作用，理解结构相似材料为何表现不同磁性行为。
AI.method: 对Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln=Gd, Ho)进行零场与纵场μSR测量，结合Redfield分析和机器学习辅助的μ子位点与偶极场计算。
AI.result: Ba3HoRu2O9在TN1=46K和TN2=10K发生两次磁有序，呈多尺度非均匀磁态（双组分弛豫、宽场分布、不完全解耦、持续自旋动力学）；Ba3GdRu2O9仅在TN=14.5K单次有序，呈较均匀反铁磁态（高斯弛豫）。
AI.conclusion: 稀土离子是Ba3LnRu2O9磁基态的强大调控参数，通过竞争性4d-4f相互作用驱动基态从均匀向复杂多尺度非均匀行为转变。

title: Enhanced Coulomb pseudopotentials in high-pressure hydrides from first principles
summary: In the Eliashberg theory of superconductivity, Coulomb interactions oppose the phonon-mediated attraction and suppress the superconducting critical temperature $T_{\mathrm{c}}$. However, most first-principles predictions continue to treat this repulsion with an empirical Coulomb pseudopotential $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ in the range 0.1-0.15. Here we present first-principles calculations of the Coulomb parameter $μ$ and pseudopotential $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ in superconducting hydrides across a range of pressures. The screened Coulomb interaction is evaluated at the random phase approximation level with the Mantel code. We demonstrate that several hydride systems, including H$_3$S, YSbH$_6$ and Mg$_2$IrH$_6$, have strong Coulomb repulsions driven by a large density of states at the Fermi energy, $N_{\mathrm{F}}$. For Mg$_2$IrH$_6$ we obtain $μ=0.62$ and $μ^*_{\text{ME}}\approx0.39$, leading to a 40 K suppression in $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ relative to a standard $μ^*_{\text{ME}}=0.16$. Our obtained $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ is far above the conventional range and, accounting for the energy dependence of the density of states, resolves the factor-of-two discrepancy between $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ estimates of previous studies. Across all systems and pressures studied, we find that $μ$ closely tracks $N_{\mathrm{F}}$, suggesting that commonly used $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ values lead to overestimated $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ in materials where the density of states at the Fermi energy is large.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理计算氢化物超导体的库仑参数μ和赝势μ*_ME，发现其远超传统范围，可解释Tc估计中两倍的差异。
AI.motivation: 多数第一性原理预测沿用经验库仑赝势μ*_ME(0.1-0.15)，可能高估高态密度材料的Tc，需要从头计算真实的库仑排斥。
AI.method: 在RPA水平下用Mantel代码计算多种氢化物在不同压力下的屏蔽库仑相互作用，得到μ及μ*_ME，并考虑费米能态密度NF的能量依赖。
AI.result: H3S、YSbH6、Mg2IrH6等体系库仑排斥强，由大NF驱动。Mg2IrH6的μ=0.62、μ*_ME≈0.39，相比μ*_ME=0.16使Tc被压低约40 K。μ*_ME远高于常规范围，解释了此前Tc估计的两倍差异。
AI.conclusion: μ随NF变化密切，常用μ*_ME值会在费米能态密度大的材料中导致Tc被高估。

title: Entropic-ordered superfluid
summary: We present a minimal classical lattice model of superfluidity at arbitrarily high temperatures, using a modified three-dimensional XY model with ``soft" rotors. The global U(1) symmetry is spontaneously broken above a positive critical temperature due to entropic order. We study hydrodynamics in this high-temperature regime and verify consistency with the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, explaining how the large noise variance at very high temperatures is not sufficient to destroy superfluidity or the long lifetime of Goldstone modes.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可在任意高温下出现超流的最简经典格点模型——带"软"转子的三维XY模型，U(1)对称性因熵序在正临界温度之上自发破缺。
AI.motivation: 通常认为热涨落会破坏序，本文想探究是否能在高温下仍维持超流及Goldstone模长寿命。
AI.method: 构造含"软"转子的改进三维XY模型作为经典格点模型，并研究其在高温区间的流体力学行为。
AI.result: 高温区存在自发U(1)对称性破缺（熵序机制），流体力学结果与涨落-耗散定理一致。
AI.conclusion: 即使高温下噪声方差很大，也不足以破坏超流或Goldstone模的长寿命。

title: Frustrated Topological Orbital Magnetism
summary: By studying the interplay of geometric frustration with Aharonov-Bohm fluxes in three dimensions, we unveil a rich playground exhibiting topological semimetallic ground states with orbital magnetic dipole, quadrupole and ferrotoroidic orders, akin to spin patterns in classical spin ices - a class of phenomena which we dub frustrated topological orbital magnetism. We demonstrate that the ground-state toroidizations underpinned by non-Abelian topological nodal lines induce measurable current-induced Hall phenomena. We further find that distinct 2-in-2-out and 3-in-1-out frustrated orbital current patterns can be associated with topological Weyl node charges, and corresponding anisotropic linear and nonlinear Hall effects. We propose signatures for experimental validation of distinct frustrated topological orbital magnetic orders in candidate materials.

AI.tldr: 本文将几何阻挫与三维Aharonov-Bohm磁通结合，揭示出一类"阻挫拓扑轨道磁性"：基态呈现轨道磁偶极、四极及铁环形序，并伴随拓扑半金属态，其非阿贝尔拓扑节线诱导可测的电流诱导霍尔现象，Weyl节点电荷对应不同阻挫轨道电流图案。
AI.motivation: 类比经典自旋冰中的阻挫自旋图案，作者希望探索几何阻挫与Aharonov-Bohm磁通相互作用能否在三维中产生新型拓扑半金属基态及轨道磁有序，从而拓展阻挫磁性与拓扑物态交叉领域。
AI.method: 通过研究三维几何阻挫与Aharonov-Bohm磁通的相互作用，分析基态轨道磁序（偶极、四极、铁环形序）及其与非阿贝尔拓扑节线、Weyl节点电荷的关联，并计算线性与非线性霍尔响应。
AI.result: 发现阻挫拓扑轨道磁基态；非阿贝尔拓扑节线支撑的环形化诱导电流诱导霍尔效应；2-in-2-out与3-in-1-out阻挫轨道电流图案分别对应Weyl节点电荷及各向异性线性与非线性霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 提出一类新的阻挫拓扑轨道磁性现象，给出候选材料中不同阻挫拓扑轨道磁序的实验验证特征（signatures）。

title: Why has PET glycolysis remained difficult to industrialize despite decades of optimization?
summary: Classical PET glycolysis struggles with industrial scale-up due to a research paradigm defect: uncoupled reaction optimization that ignores system-level engineering entropy. By establishing a governing reference frame, Scientific Reasoning Units (SRUs) and human-AI collaborative discovery in this article, we present a Three-Step Synergistic Reinforcement Paradigm addressing the triple failure modes of traditional systems-mass-transfer collapse, viscosity deadlock, and side-reaction accumulation. By integrating twin-screw controlled shearing, solid-state micro-homogenization, and deep depolymerization (2:1 EG/Oligomer ratio), we achieve an ultrafast kinetic regime. BHET yields surge to 80% to 95% within 10 minutes, eliminating multi-hour thermal bottlenecks and delivering an economically viable framework for closed-loop polyester recycling.

AI.tldr: 提出三步协同强化范式，通过双螺杆剪切、固态微均质与深度解聚实现PET快速醇解，10分钟内BHET收率达80-95%。
AI.motivation: 传统PET醇解存在研究范式缺陷：反应优化相互解耦、忽视系统级工程熵，导致难以工业化放大，并面临传质崩溃、黏度死锁、副反应累积三重失效。
AI.method: 建立统辖参考框架、科学推理单元（SRUs）与人机协同发现机制；采用三步协同强化（双螺杆受控剪切、固态微均质化、以2:1 EG/低聚物比深度解聚）。
AI.result: 进入超快动力学区，BHET收率在10分钟内提升至80-95%，消除数小时热瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 提供经济可行的闭环聚酯回收框架，克服传统系统三重失效模式。

title: The quantum geometry of the chemical bond
summary: Electronic properties of materials depend both on band energies and quantum geometry of electronic states. We relate bonding indices to the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), showing how chemical bonding dictates the momentum-space texture of bands, bridging chemical and physical descriptions of solids. We show the QGT decomposed into the three center bond index, weighted by their oriented area. Resolving these contributions by orbital pair reveals the donor--acceptor character that distinguish ionic, covalent, hypervalent, and metavalent bonding. We identify the bonding pattern for topology in materials: noncollinear three center bonds, which are the source of Berry curvature in solids. Bond fluctuation can be directly linked to electromagnetic response by resolving their energy spectrum, opening a quantitative route towards the design of physical properties of materials from bonding motifs.

AI.tldr: 本文建立化学键与量子几何张量(QGT)的联系，揭示键合模式如何决定能带的动量空间结构，并以此统一描述固体的化学与物理性质。
AI.motivation: 材料的电子性质既取决于能带能量，也取决于电子态的量子几何，但化学键与量子几何之间的定量联系尚不清晰，需要一座连接化学键合描述与物理能带描述的桥梁。
AI.method: 将量子几何张量分解为三中心键指数，并以它们的有向面积加权；按轨道对分辨这些贡献，从而提取供体-受体特征。
AI.result: 轨道对分辨的贡献揭示了区分离子键、共价键、超价键和金属价键的供体-受体特征；识别出材料中拓扑性的键合模式——非共线三中心键是固体中贝里曲率的来源；键涨落能谱可关联电磁响应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从键合基元定量设计材料物理性质的路径，统一了化学与物理对固体的描述。

title: Parallel Design of a GPU-Resident Semi-Lagrangian Drift-Kinetic Solver on Unstructured Extruded Tokamak Meshes
summary: Semi-Lagrangian (SL) schemes advect a distribution function along characteristics and remap it to a fixed grid. They are unconditionally stable without a global solve, and with discontinuous Galerkin (DG) integration the transfer along a magnetic field line conserves mass exactly. This paper presents the parallel and GPU design of a 3X+2V SLDG drift-kinetic tokamak solver on unstructured, flux-surface-aligned poloidal planes of shaped cross section, extruded toroidally. Transport follows magnetic field lines across the planes, and each velocity channel advances a fixed distance per step, proportional to its parallel speed, so the halo depth a channel needs grows with its speed. Velocity-dependent ragged halos exploit this, sending each channel only its own upwind depth. The 4D decomposition includes the toroidal angle, the 2D poloidal plane and the magnetic moment, and leaves the parallel velocity whole: no stage transports across the magnetic moment, while a parallel-velocity partition would put a halo inside the acceleration stage. On NVIDIA A100s the design strong-scales over the magnetic-moment axis from one to 12 four-GPU nodes, and a weak series of three points refining all five phase-space dimensions together, 16x in total per series point, holds a weak-scaling efficiency of 75% on 16 GPUs and 57% on 256, from a one-GPU base case. The pointwise interpolations within the poloidal plane do not conserve mass, and the full step's mass drift stays below 2.1x10^-5 at every series point. The design was implemented with an AI code assistant under a machine-checked regression discipline, in which every change is held to one of four exactness classes, from bit-identical to a physics rate within a stated tolerance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在非结构、磁面贴合的极向平面上的3X+2V半拉格朗日间断伽辽金漂移动理学托卡马克求解器，并给出其并行与GPU设计。
AI.motivation: 半拉格朗日格式无条件稳定且无需全局求解，配合DG可实现沿磁力线的精确质量守恒；需要为复杂几何下的漂移动理学求解器设计高效并行/GPU方案。
AI.method: 沿磁力线输运；每个速度通道按平行速度推进固定距离，采用速度相关的ragged halo只发送各通道所需的上风深度；4D分解涵盖环向角、2D极向平面和磁矩，保持平行速度完整以避免加速阶段的halo；在A100上实现并用AI代码助手配合机器校验的回归规范开发，每次改动归入四类精确性等级。
AI.result: 磁矩轴强扩展从1个到12个四GPU节点；弱扩展三点系列（五个相空间维同时细化共16x）在16 GPU上效率75%、256 GPU上57%（以单GPU为基准）；全步质量漂移始终低于2.1x10^-5。
AI.conclusion: 速度相关ragged halo与4D分解设计可有效扩展至多GPU；极向平面内逐点插值不守恒质量但整体漂移极小。

title: Quadratic XY-anisotropy correction to the spontaneous staggered magnetization of the gapped XYZ spin-$1/2$ chain
summary: The staggered order parameter of the gapped XYZ spin-$1/2$ chain follows from the eight-vertex solution, but in elliptic variables that fix the Hamiltonian couplings only implicitly. We derive a closed form for the coefficient governing the leading quadratic response of the spontaneous staggered magnetization to the XY anisotropy at fixed longitudinal anisotropy in the gapped antiferromagnetic regime. Starting from the Baxter--Kelland--Jimbo--Miwa--Nakayashiki polarization formula, we show that at fixed longitudinal anisotropy both the modular nome and the crossing-parameter variable of the formula move with the XY anisotropy, and that the motion of the crossing-parameter variable reverses the sign of the expansion at fixed elliptic variables. The coefficient is a rational term plus a Lambert series. It is strictly negative and bounded above by a rational function of the longitudinal anisotropy, to which it is asymptotic in the Ising limit. At the isotropic point it diverges as the inverse five-halves power of the distance to that point, and since the Lambert sum has an asymptotic expansion with exponentially small remainder, the subleading terms of the divergence also follow in closed form. When the XY anisotropy vanishes as the five-fourths power of the distance to the isotropic point, the ratio of the perturbed to the unperturbed order parameter tends to a Gaussian in the scaling variable, and the quadratic truncation is controlled when that variable is small. A fourth-order perturbative calculation in the spin chain, with no input from the eight-vertex solution, reproduces the leading strong-coupling behaviour, and infinite-DMRG calculations at four anisotropies in the gapped regime are consistent with the closed form.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了有能隙 XYZ 自旋-1/2 链中交错磁化强度对 XY 各向异性响应的领头二次项系数的闭式表达式，为有理项加 Lambert 级数。
AI.motivation: 八顶点解给出的交错序参量以椭圆变量表达，仅隐式确定哈密顿量耦合，难以直接分析对 XY 各向异性的响应。作者希望得到显式、封闭的解析形式。
AI.method: 从 Baxter–Kelland–Jimbo–Miwa–Nakayashiki 极化公式出发，考虑模数权和交叉参数变量随 XY 各向异性的变化，并作四阶微扰计算及无限 DMRG 数值验证。
AI.result: 系数为有理项加 Lambert 级数，严格为负且被纵向各向异性的有理函数上界控制；在 Ising 极限下渐近于该上界，在各向同性点以距离的 -5/2 次幂发散，并可闭式给出次领头项。当 XY 各向异性按各向同性点距离的 5/4 次幂消失时，扰动与未扰动序参量之比趋于高斯型。
AI.conclusion: 四阶微扰与四个各向异性下的无限 DMRG 结果均与闭式一致，验证了解析推导。

title: Electron- and hole-doped superconductivity in two-dimensional electride ZrX$_2$ (X = Cl, Br, I)
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) superconducting systems have recently emerged as a frontier in condensed matter physics, driven by their unique physical properties and potential applications. Using first-principles calculations, we show that monolayer ZrX$_2$ (X = Cl, Br, I), which is a family of 2D semiconducting electrides, hosts phonon-mediated superconductivity under both electron and hole dopings. Electron doping in ZrX$_{2}$ can achieve high superconducting transition temperatures at very low concentrations, with ZrBr$_2$ reaching $T_c = 30.0$ K at 0.01 \textit{e}/f.u., followed by ZrCl$_2$ (22.5 K at 0.05 \textit{e}/f.u.) and ZrI$_2$ (18.1 K at 0.01 \textit{e}/f.u.), for which the high $T_c$ originates from the flat conduction band minimum, with Van Hove singularities nearby enhancing the density of states. In contrast, hole doping requires higher concentrations (0.2--0.25 \textit{h}/f.u.) to activate superconductivity, yielding $T_c \sim 2$ K, and approaches a magnetic instability at elevated doping levels. By comparing with InSe and LaBr$_2$, we identify the spatial location and orbital character of excess electrons as key factors determining the strength of hole-doped superconductivity and the nature of competing orders. These findings establish monolayer ZrX$_2$ as a platform for bipolar superconductivity in a 2D electride and provide insights into flat-band engineering for high-$T_c$ superconductors.

AI.tldr: 单层ZrX₂（X=Cl, Br, I）作为2D半导体电子化物，通过第一性原理计算证明其在电子和空穴掺杂下均呈现声子介导超导性，电子掺杂可实现高达30 K的Tc。
AI.motivation: 二维超导系统是凝聚态物理前沿，具有独特物性和应用潜力。作者希望探索2D电子化物中的双极性超导性，并理解平带工程对高Tc超导的调控机制。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，研究单层ZrX₂（X=Cl, Br, I）在电子掺杂与空穴掺杂下的声子介导超导性，并与InSe和LaBr₂进行对比，分析过量电子的空间位置和轨道特征。
AI.result: 电子掺杂下，极低浓度即实现高Tc：ZrBr₂在0.01 e/f.u.时Tc=30.0 K，ZrCl₂在0.05 e/f.u.时22.5 K，ZrI₂在0.01 e/f.u.时18.1 K，源于平带导带底及邻近Van Hove奇异性增强态密度。空穴掺杂需更高浓度（0.2–0.25 h/f.u.），Tc仅约2 K，且高掺杂下趋近磁不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 单层ZrX₂是2D电子化物中双极性超导的平台，过量电子的空间位置与轨道特征决定空穴掺杂超导强度和竞争序性质，为平带工程设计高Tc超导体提供思路。

title: Spectral optimization of spherical lattices and applications to classical and quantum interacting spin systems
summary: We develop an optimization algorithm for spherical lattice discretizations based on the spectrum of the discretized Laplace operator. Starting from refined icosahedral lattices, we minimize the splitting of the $(2\ell+1)$, $\ell=0,1,2,\dots$, continuum multiplets expected from $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ symmetry via gradient descent. This approach simultaneously produces lattices based on triangles with nearly uniform circumradii and perimeters. Although the optimization uses only the free-particle spectrum, we show that the resulting lattices carry over to interacting models. On the optimized lattices, rotational symmetry is restored for the critical Ising and Potts models and primary scaling dimensions are accurately reproduced for the three-dimensional Ising conformal field theory, when appropriate geometry-dependent interaction strengths are used. Higher-angular-momentum descendant states reveal weak residual symmetry breaking beyond the sectors protected by the underlying icosahedral symmetry.

AI.tldr: 提出基于离散拉普拉斯算符谱的球面格点优化算法，可恢复相互作用模型的旋转对称性并准确复现临界指数。
AI.motivation: 球面离散化（如二十面体细化格点）会破坏连续SO(3)旋转对称性，给在该格点上研究共形场论和临界现象带来困难。
AI.method: 从细化的二十面体格点出发，通过梯度下降最小化连续多重态(2ℓ+1)的劈裂，同时使三角形格点的外接圆半径与周长几乎均匀。优化仅使用自由粒子谱，但被验证可迁移到相互作用模型（配合几何相关的相互作用强度）。
AI.result: 优化后的格点上，临界Ising与Potts模型恢复了旋转对称性；使用合适的几何相关相互作用强度时，三维Ising共形场论的主标度维度被精确复现。高角动量后代态显示在二十面体对称保护扇区之外存在微弱残余对称破缺。
AI.conclusion: 基于自由粒子谱的几何优化能有效构建保留旋转对称性的球面格点，可用于相互作用共形场论的数值研究。

title: Entropy Production in Mesoscopic Electronic Transport Beyond Weak-Coupling
summary: We investigate the full statistics of entropy production in coherent mesoscopic conductors beyond the weak-coupling regime. Using the inside-outside perspective and the Landauer-Büttiker scattering framework, we relate entropy production to the full counting statistics of particle transport and show that the corresponding cumulant-generating function satisfies the fluctuation symmetry independently of the coupling strength. We obtain closed analytical expressions for the cumulant-generating function in the weak- and strong-coupling limits, enabling a detailed characterization of entropy production distributions and higher-order cumulants. These cumulants reveal distinct signatures of resonant transport and coherent fermionic partitioning. While coupling-induced broadening substantially modifies the transport statistics, the fluctuation symmetry imposed by microscopic reversibility remains preserved in the long-time limit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了相干介观导体中熵产生的全统计，适用于任意耦合强度，通过Landauer-Büttiker散射框架将熵产生与粒子输运的全计数统计联系起来，并证明其满足涨落对称性。
AI.motivation: 以往对介观导体熵产生的研究多局限于弱耦合区，缺乏对超出弱耦合、任意耦合强度下熵产生全统计的系统刻画。
AI.method: 采用inside-outside视角与Landauer-Büttiker散射理论，关联熵产生与粒子输运的全计数统计，给出弱耦合与强耦合极限下累积量生成函数的闭式解析表达式。
AI.result: 累积量生成函数在任意耦合强度下满足涨落对称性；得到弱、强耦合极限的解析结果，可刻画熵产生分布与高阶累积量，揭示共振输运与相干费米子分配的独特特征；耦合诱导的展宽显著改变输运统计，但微观可逆性导致的涨落对称性在长时极限下仍保持。
AI.conclusion: 熵产生的涨落对称性独立于耦合强度，耦合展宽只改变输运统计而不破坏长期涨落对称性，为强耦合介观体系热电与量子输运研究提供基础。

title: Exciton Energy Transfer in Conjugated Polymers via a Three-Level Donor-Acceptor Model
summary: We investigate intra-chain exciton energy transfer (EET) in a conjugated polymer using a reduced three-level donor-acceptor model that separates vertical excitations from vibrationally relaxed states. Population dynamics are obtained with the hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM), enabling a non-Markovian treatment of system-bath (S-B) interactions. Case studies on donor-acceptor (D-A) pairs with small and large energy gaps reveal competition among coherent hopping, vibrational relaxation, and Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET). Varying the hopping and the S-B relaxation rate highlights roles of exciton transfer, thermal relaxation, and dipole-mediated coupling. The results show that energy gap, hopping, and relaxation jointly control intrachain EET.

AI.tldr: 本文用约化三能级D-A模型和HEOM方法研究共轭聚合物链内激子能量转移（EET），揭示能隙、跳跃和弛豫共同调控EET。
AI.motivation: 探究共轭聚合物链内激子能量转移机制，理清相干跳跃、振动弛豫与FRET之间的竞争关系。
AI.method: 采用分离垂直激发与振动弛豫态的约化三能级供体-受体模型，用层级运动方程（HEOM）获得布居动力学，实现非马尔可夫的系统-环境处理；通过对小、大能隙D-A对及不同跳跃和S-B弛豫速率的算例进行分析。
AI.result: 在小、大能隙D-A对中观察到相干跳跃、振动弛豫和FRET的竞争；调节跳跃和S-B弛豫速率可突显激子转移、热弛豫与偶极介导耦合的作用。
AI.conclusion: 能隙、跳跃和弛豫共同控制链内EET。

title: Corrugated Niobene: Stability, Mechanical and Electronic Properties from First-Principles Calculations
summary: The growing diversity of two-dimensional (2D) materials has expanded opportunities in electronics, energy technologies, catalysis, and optical applications. Within this landscape, understanding how corrugated architectures accommodate metallic bonding and influence the stability and properties of monoelemental niobium sheets remains an open research direction. Here, we propose a corrugated niobene nanosheet, denoted c-Nb, and investigate its structural, energetic, vibrational, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties using density functional theory simulations. The optimized structure adopts a centrosymmetric P-3m1 symmetry, with six atoms per primitive cell and a geometrical thickness of 4.279 Angstrom. Its cohesive energy of -6.03 eV/atom indicates strong binding relative to isolated atoms, although bulk BCC Nb remains energetically favored by 2.49 eV/atom. The absence of imaginary phonon frequencies along the investigated high-symmetry path and the positive-definite in-plane stiffness matrix support dynamical and mechanical structural stability. Despite its pronounced corrugation, the nanosheet exhibits isotropic in-plane elasticity, with Young's and shear moduli of 43.66 N/m and 13.66 N/m, respectively, and a Poisson's ratio of 0.598. Electronic states near the Fermi level are dominated by Nb 4d orbitals, establishing multiband metallicity. These findings identify a corrugated structural candidate that combines strong cohesion, elastic compliance, and metallic electronic behavior, extending the structural diversity of monoelemental 2D metals and providing a basis for further exploration of niobium nanosheets in electronic and ultraviolet-responsive systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种褶皱铌烯纳米片 c-Nb，用 DFT 研究其结构、稳定性、力学、电子与光学性质，证实其为稳定的金属性二维单元素材料。
AI.motivation: 二维材料家族日益丰富，但褶皱结构如何在单元素铌片中容纳金属键、并影响其稳定性与性质，仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟，对 c-Nb 的几何、能量、声子、力学、电子和光学性质进行计算。
AI.result: 优化结构为中心对称 P-3m1，原胞6原子，厚度4.279 Å；内聚能-6.03 eV/atom，但比体相 BCC Nb 高2.49 eV/atom；无虚频声子、刚度矩阵正定，动力学与力学稳定；面内弹性各向同性，杨氏模量43.66 N/m、剪切模量13.66 N/m、泊松比0.598；费米能级附近由 Nb 4d 轨道主导，呈多带金属性。
AI.conclusion: c-Nb 兼具强内聚、弹性柔顺与金属电子行为，拓展了单元素二维金属的结构多样性，为电子与紫外响应器件研究提供基础。

title: Polyconvex neural-network surrogates with learned paired directional features for anisotropic hyperelastic homogenization
summary: Approximating the effective anisotropic hyperelastic response of a representative volume element (RVE) requires constitutive expressiveness, mechanical consistency, and computational efficiency. This work develops a polyconvex physics-augmented neural network (PANN) construction based on paired directional features whose orientations, stretch powers, and determinant exponents adapt to the RVE response. The features are composed with convex, componentwise nondecreasing cores, realized as an input-convex neural network (ICNN) or an input-convex Kolmogorov-Arnold network (ICKAN). The complete energies satisfy objectivity, an exactly stress-free reference, two-dimensional polyconvexity, and prescribed growth conditions by construction, and nonnegative energy is certified separately for the selected models. On a multicavity and a single-cavity periodic cell, these energies are compared with an Unconstrained energy, trained identically without the curvature and growth constraints, and with three hyperreduced projection-based reduced-order models (HPROMs), which serve as physics-based references. On the first cell, learning the features lowers the stress error sevenfold, and six features suffice on both. The constrained energies remain below one percent in stress error and in the displacement error of a tensile-coupon FE$^2$ application with a full-order reference, whereas the Unconstrained energy and the HPROMs are more accurate inside the data. Beyond the data, however, the Unconstrained energy loses rank-one convexity, and under confined compression it stops below half of the 500 MPa that the constrained energies reach. These results quantify what the guarantees cost in accuracy and what they secure beyond the data.

AI.tldr: 提出基于配对方向特征的polyconvex PANN，用ICNN/ICKAN作凸核，构建满足客观性、无应力参考、二维polyconvex性和增长条件的各向异性超弹本构，精度接近无约束模型与HPROM且外推稳定。
AI.motivation: RVE有效各向异性超弹响应近似需兼顾本构表达能力、力学一致性与计算效率，现有方法难以在保证物理约束的同时维持精度。
AI.method: 以方向和、拉伸幂、行列式指数自适应的配对方向特征为输入，与凸且逐分量非减的ICNN或ICKAN核复合；构造时即满足客观性、精确无应力参考态、二维polyconvex性及指定增长条件，并单独验证非负能量；在多腔与单腔周期胞元上同无约束能量及三种HPROM对比。
AI.result: 学习特征使应力误差降低7倍，两种胞元均只需6个特征；约束模型在拉伸试样FE²应用中应力与位移误差均低于1%，而训练域内的无约束模型与HPROM更准；域外无约束模型失去rank-one凸性，受限压缩下应力不足约束模型500 MPa的一半。
AI.conclusion: 该polyconvex PANN以极小精度代价换取严格力学保证，并在数据域外保持稳定与更高承载响应，量化了保证条件的代价与收益。

title: Ground-State Phase Diagram of the Effective Model with Antiferromagnetic Nearest-Neighbor and Ferromagnetic Next-Nearest-Neighbor Interactions in 1/1 Periodic Approximants to Icosahedral Quasicrystals
summary: By performing complete enumeration of all configurations of magnetic moments, we have determined the ground-state phase diagram of the effective model with antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor interactions $J_1$ and ferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbor interactions $J_2$ on the 1/1 periodic approximant to icosahedral quasicrystal. Depending on the ratio of $J_2/J_1$ and the magnetic anisotropy arising from the crystalline electric field, various non-collinear ferrimagnetic orders and antiferromagnetic orders are shown to be stabilized, whose magnetic space groups are identified as $R\bar{3}$, $C2'/m'$, $Pm'm'2$ and $I_{\rm P}m'\bar{3}'$. We have revealed the topological as well as magnetic property of each ground state with degeneracy, which is useful to understand experimental observations of magnetic structures and domains in the rare-earth-based 1/1 approximants.

AI.tldr: 通过完全枚举磁矩构型，确定了二十面体准晶1/1近似相上具有反铁磁最近邻J1与铁磁次近邻J2相互作用有效模型的基态相图，识别出多种非共线亚铁磁和反铁磁序及其磁空间群。
AI.motivation: 理解稀土基1/1近似相中磁结构与磁畴的实验观测，需要确定该体系中竞争相互作用下的基态磁性相及其对称性。
AI.method: 对二十面体准晶1/1周期近似相上包含反铁磁最近邻相互作用J1和铁磁次近邻相互作用J2的有效模型，进行磁矩构型的完全枚举，并考虑晶体电场引起的磁各向异性。
AI.result: 根据J2/J1比值和磁各向异性，稳定了多种非共线亚铁磁序和反铁磁序，其磁空间群被识别为R3̄、C2'/m'、Pm'm'2和I_P m'3̄'；并揭示了各具有简并度的基态的拓扑与磁性性质。
AI.conclusion: 所获得的基态相图及磁空间群识别有助于理解稀土基1/1近似相中磁结构和磁畴的实验观测。

title: Altermagnetic Control of Charge-4e Superconductivity
summary: We present, to our knowledge, the first theoretical realization of an independent charge-4e phase in a two-dimensional classical array of conventional superconductors coupled through altermagnetic junctions. Tuning the altermagnetic splitting suppresses the leading single-pair tunneling harmonic while retaining strong double-pair coupling, producing a finite charge-4e region between staggered and uniform charge-2e states. Using the complete temperature-dependent microscopic Josephson spectrum, we find short-range ordinary pair correlations alongside algebraic coherence of pairs of Cooper pairs. Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless scaling and a half-flux response further identify the charge-4e phase. Our results establish altermagnetism as a microscopic means to select between ordinary and composite superconducting coherence.

AI.tldr: 该文首次在二维常规超导体经交变磁性结耦合的经典阵列中理论实现了独立的 charge-4e 相。
AI.motivation: 探索由交变磁性作为微观机制，在常规超导体中实现并选择复合（charge-4e）超导相干态，而非普通 charge-2e 相干。
AI.method: 构建二维常规超导体经交变磁性结耦合的经典阵列；通过调节交变磁性劈裂抑制单对隧穿谐波、保留强双对耦合；利用完整温度依赖的微观 Josephson 谱进行分析。
AI.result: 在交错与均匀 charge-2e 态之间出现有限 charge-4e 区域；存在短程普通配对关联与库珀对配对的代数相干；BKT 标度与半通量响应进一步确认 charge-4e 相。
AI.conclusion: 交变磁性可作为微观手段在普通与复合超导相干之间进行选择，确立其在实现 charge-4e 相中的作用。

title: Graph-theoretic framework for semi-Markov networks: transient and stationary occupation probabilities, hitting times and weak ergodicity breaking
summary: Semi-Markov networks provide a natural framework for describing stochastic transitions between coarse-grained states with non-exponential dwell times, with applications ranging from biophysics and neuroscience to epidemiology and finance. Here, it is shown that finite semi-Markov networks admit explicit combinatorial representations of their Laplace-transformed occupation probabilities and hitting-time distributions as sums over weighted spanning trees and forests of an augmented graph. These representations yield asymptotic results, including a generalization of the Markov Chain Tree Theorem to semi-Markov networks, in which the rate constants replaced by pseudo-rates given by the inverse mean sojourn time weighted by the exit probability through this channel, as well as the long-time scaling of hitting-time survival probabilities in the presence of infinite-mean sojourn times. They also extend recently derived combinatorial formulas for hitting-time moments to the semi-Markov setting. In particular, the mean hitting-time formula coincides with that of a Markov network with the corresponding pseudo-rates, which also yields a short proof of the constancy of Kemeny's constant for finite-mean semi-Markov networks. Finally, we use the same framework to show that weak ergodicity breaking occurs generically for time-additive state observables that are nonconstant on the support of the limiting distribution in heavy-tailed semi-Markov networks.

AI.tldr: 有限半马尔可夫网络的拉普拉斯变换占据概率与首达时间分布可用增广图上加权生成树/森林的组合和表示，给出Markov链树定理推广、首达时间矩公式及弱遍历破缺结果。
AI.motivation: 半马尔可夫网络能描述非指数驻留时间的粗粒化状态转移，应用广泛，但缺乏类似马尔可夫链树的组合刻画与渐近结果。
AI.method: 在增广图上构造组合表示，将拉普拉斯变换后的占据概率和首达时间分布写成加权生成树与森林之和，并由此推导渐近性质。
AI.result: 得到半马尔可夫版的Markov链树定理（率常数由伪率替代），无限均值驻留下首达时间生存概率的长时标度，首达时间矩公式（均值与伪率马尔可夫网络一致），以及Kemeny常数在有限均值下半马尔可夫网络中的恒定性，并证明重尾网络中弱遍历破缺的普遍性。
AI.conclusion: 该组合框架统一并推广了马尔可夫链的树定理与首达时间结果到半马尔可夫情形，并揭示了重尾下时间可加状态观测量的弱遍历破缺。

title: Electron binding by charge disorder surrounding gapped bilayer graphene
summary: Bilayer graphene (BLG) is a unique electronic material offering electrostatic tunability of its band gap. Here, we study how charge disorder in the dielectric environment modifies band-edge states by binding electrons and holes to Coulomb centres, taking into account the in- and out-of-plane dielectric response of Bernal bilayers. We apply this framework to (a) hBN-encapsulated medium-size-gap BLG used for gate-defined quantum dots, and (b) BLG under double n/p ionic gating. In hBN/BLG/hBN, we find that single remote charges produce only weakly bound states, with binding energies generally small compared with the BLG gap. Under ionic gating, we find that the bound states are too large to be trapped by individual ions -- localisation arises from fluctuations in the ion density, whose magnitude is limited by Coulomb charging energy at the freezing temperature $T_f$ of the ionic configuration. Thus, in both regimes, charge disorder does not produce deep midgap states, with the bound states remaining closer to the conduction and valence band edges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究介电环境中电荷无序如何通过库仑中心束缚电子/空穴来改变双层石墨烯的带边态，并应用于hBN封装BLG和离子栅控BLG两种体系。
AI.motivation: 双层石墨烯带隙可静电调节，是量子点等器件的候选材料，但介电环境中的电荷无序可能引入带隙内束缚态，影响器件性能，需要定量理解其影响。
AI.method: 建立考虑Bernal双层石墨烯面内与面外介电响应的理论框架，计算单个远程电荷束缚电子/空穴的结合能，并应用于(a) hBN封装的介质隙BLG量子点与(b)双重n/p离子栅控BLG。
AI.result: 在hBN/BLG/hBN中，单个远程电荷只产生弱束缚态，结合能远小于BLG带隙；在离子栅控下，束缚态过大无法被单个离子俘获，局域化来自离子密度涨落，其幅度受冻结温度T_f下的库仑充电能限制。
AI.conclusion: 两种体系中电荷无序均不产生深带隙中态，束缚态始终靠近导带和价带带边。

title: Looking Under the Streetlight: Evaluation in Generative Molecular Dynamics
summary: This position paper argues that the generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) community is not properly evaluating its progress: current evaluations let a model match what is reported while being arbitrarily wrong on what was claimed, which risks over-claiming advantage over classical baselines. This reflects a structural misalignment between common evaluation practices and the scientific tasks the field sets for itself. The reason is that the ground truth---exhaustive molecular dynamics on the systems of interest---is computationally costly, and this cost is what motivates the field. With ground truth inaccessible, evaluation drifts toward convenient proxies, and the resulting norms entrench easily. We identify misaligned evaluation patterns that persist as a community-level equilibrium, and propose concrete observables, reporting standards, and benchmark designs, both computational and experimental, that better reflect what GenMD aspires to deliver. Our aim is to give the field shared language and tools for evaluation that match its scientific ambitions before today's conventions calcify into norms.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，指出生成式分子动力学（GenMD）领域的评估实践与科学目标存在结构性错位，并呼吁在惯例固化前建立更合理的评估标准。
AI.motivation: 当前GenMD评估让模型"匹配所报告的内容，却在所声称的内容上任意出错"，有过度宣称优于经典基线的风险。根本原因在于真实基准（对目标系统的穷举分子动力学）计算代价高昂，而这一代价恰恰是该领域存在的动机所在。
AI.method: 作为立场论文，作者不含实验，而是概念性分析：诊断评估实践与科学任务之间的结构性错位；识别作为社区层面均衡而持续存在的错位评估模式；提出具体的可观测量、报告标准和基准设计。
AI.result: 识别出一系列持续存在（作为社区均衡）的错位评估模式；提出涵盖计算与实验两类的新评估方案，旨在更好反映GenMD真正希望交付的能力。
AI.conclusion: 目标是趁当前惯例尚未固化为规范之前，为该领域提供与其科学雄心相匹配的共享语言和评估工具。

title: Dynamic Chemical Changes of Ti3C2Tx MXenes in Halide Perovskite Precursor Environments
summary: The integration of two-dimensional Ti3C2Tx MXenes into Halide Perovskite (HaP) optoelectronics has shown immense potential for enhancing device performance, yet the fundamental chemical interactions within the precursor ink (a critical stage determining the final material state) remain largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive investigation into the chemical stability and surface evolution of Ti3C2Tx MXenes when exposed to the individual and combined components of a model methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI3) solution. By combining detailed X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) analysis with Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations, we decouple the complex interactions between MXenes and the ink constituents. We demonstrate that elemental iodine (I2) and polyiodides (In-) act as aggressive oxidizers, triggering rapid degradation and dissolution of the MXene flakes. Conversely, lead iodide (PbI2) induces a slower oxidation process driven by the strong adsorption of Pb2+ ions onto oxygen terminated sites. In stark contrast, methylammonium iodide (MAI) exhibits a stabilizing effect: it adsorbs onto the MXene surface via hydrogen bonding, effectively passivating the flakes and retarding degradation. In addition, our results reveal that the sequence of precursor addition governs the MXene surface state, requiring extra caution, but also enabling further tunability. These findings provide a critical view on how MXene integration with materials, in general, and HaP in particular, should be perceived, providing a fundamental for their rational engineering.

AI.tldr: 研究Ti3C2Tx MXene在MAPbI3前驱体墨水中的化学稳定性与表面演化，揭示各组分对MXene的氧化/稳定作用及添加顺序的影响。
AI.motivation: MXene与卤化物钙钛矿光电子器件集成潜力巨大，但前驱体墨水阶段（决定最终材料状态的关键环节）的化学相互作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 将Ti3C2Tx MXene分别暴露于MAPbI3模型溶液的单一及组合组分中，结合XPS分析与DFT计算，解耦MXene与墨水组分间的复杂相互作用。
AI.result: I2和聚碘化物(In-)是强氧化剂，导致MXene快速降解溶解；PbI2通过Pb2+在氧终止位点的强吸附引发较慢氧化；MAI通过氢键吸附起钝化稳定作用、延缓降解；前驱体添加顺序决定MXene表面状态。
AI.conclusion: 为MXene与材料（尤其钙钛矿）集成的认知提供关键视角，奠定其理性工程设计的基础。

title: All-electron RT-TDDFT with Exact Exchange based on Numeric Atom-centered Orbitals for Condensed Matter
summary: Real-time time-dependent density functional theory (RT-TDDFT) has become a widely used first-principles method for studying excited-state and nonequilibrium electron dynamics. Hybrid exchange-correlation (XC) functionals, which incorporate a fraction of nonlocal exact exchange, are particularly important for accurately describing processes such as charge transfer and hot-carrier dynamics. However, the high computational cost which accompanies exact exchange, as required in hybrid XC functionals, has largely restricted RT-TDDFT simulations of condensed matter systems to using semi-local XC functionals. In this work, we present an all-electron implementation of exact exchange for RT-TDDFT based on numeric atom-centered orbitals, extending an efficient ground-state resolution-of-identity (RI) framework to the complex, time-dependent Hamiltonians required for real-time propagation. We validate the implementation against an established RI approach, for an isolated water molecule, finding exact agreement for both valence and core (K-edge) excitations. We also demonstrate the method on two extended periodic systems, crystalline silicon and silicon carbide. For silicon, the HSE06 spectrum reproduces previously reported real-time TDDFT results and agrees with experiment to within approximately 0.2~eV, consistent with plane-wave pseudopotential implementations. For silicon carbide, we compute valence and X-ray absorption spectra at the silicon $L$-edge and carbon $K$-edge. These results establish an efficient, all-electron route to hybrid-XC functional RT-TDDFT for both molecular and condensed matter systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于数值原子中心轨道的全电子精确交换RT-TDDFT实现，通过扩展RI框架支持复时变哈密顿量，可用于分子和凝聚态体系。
AI.motivation: 混合泛函中的精确交换对电荷转移、热载流子动力学等过程至关重要，但其高计算成本使RT-TDDFT对凝聚态体系的模拟大多只能使用半局域泛函。
AI.method: 基于数值原子中心轨道，将高效基态RI框架扩展至实时传播所需的复时变哈密顿量，实现全电子精确交换RT-TDDFT。
AI.result: 孤立水分子与既有RI方法在价电子和芯（K边）激发上完全一致；晶体硅的HSE06谱再现文献结果并与实验吻合约0.2 eV；碳化硅计算了硅L边和碳K边的价电子及X射线吸收谱。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分子和凝聚态体系提供了高效的全电子混合泛函RT-TDDFT途径。

title: Real-Time Relaxation Dynamics of Dark Excitons in Mirror-Symmetric Monolayers
summary: Symmetry governs which exciton-phonon (\textit{exc-ph}) scattering channels \textit{can} exist, but not which a relaxing exciton actually uses. Combining group theory with \textit{ab initio} many-body perturbation theory, we derive the mirror parity $σ_h$, of finite-momentum excitons in planar $D_{3h}$ monolayers, and form exact \textit{exc-ph} selection rules that hold across the whole Brillouin zone. The parity of the lowest exciton band changes across a closed contour. The even phonons connect states of the same parity, while odd phonons connect states of opposite parity. We use these rules to compute exciton linewidths and we solve the real-time Boltzmann transport equation for monolayer GaN as the test case and benchmark it against monolayer \textit{h}BN.

AI.tldr: 结合群论与从头算多体微扰理论，推导平面D3h单层中有限动量激子的镜面宇称σ_h，建立全布里渊区严格的激子-声子选择定则，并用于计算激子线宽及求解实时玻尔兹曼输运方程。
AI.motivation: 对称性只能决定哪些激子-声子散射通道可以存在，但不能说明弛豫激子实际使用哪些通道，因此需要更严格的宇称分析与选择定则。
AI.method: 结合群论与从头算多体微扰理论，推导平面D3h单层中有限动量激子的镜面宇称σ_h，并建立全布里渊区适用的激子-声子选择定则；再据此计算激子线宽，并求解实时玻尔兹曼输运方程。
AI.result: 最低激子带的宇称沿一条闭合轮廓发生变化；偶声子连接相同宇称态，奇声子连接相反宇称态。以单层GaN为测试案例，并与单层hBN进行基准比较。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了有限动量激子-声子耦合的严格宇称选择定则，可准确描述激子弛豫与线宽，并在GaN与hBN单层中得到验证。

title: Scalene Yang-Baxter triples realize all nearest-neighbour Hamiltonians with global additive symmetries
summary: We establish that bond Hamiltonian densities, up to local difference terms whose sum vanishes under periodic boundary conditions, lying in the commutant of bond operators, $w_j\pm w_{j+1}$, is a necessary and sufficient condition for a one-dimensional nearest-neighbour Hamiltonian to conserve a uniform or staggered sum of the one-site operators $w_j$. Starting from these local commutants, we show that every such Hamiltonian and its conserved charge can be obtained from monodromy matrices constructed using regular and non-regular members of scalene Yang-Baxter triples. The results hold on periodic chains of length $L\geq3$, with even length required in the staggered case. The results do not require translation invariance, and hence the interaction on each bond can be chosen independently from the full corresponding commutant. Our representation-independent construction applies in arbitrary finite local dimension and exhausts the Hamiltonians with either prescribed additive symmetry, without requiring ordinary Yang-Baxter integrability. We illustrate the construction with spin-$\tfrac12$ and spin-1 systems and discuss its relation to the double-commutant theorem. Classifying the one-site generators $w$ and their associated bond commutants provides a route to classifying such Hamiltonians with additive conserved charges.

AI.tldr: 该文给出了一维最近邻哈密顿量守恒均匀/交错单点算符和式的充要条件：键哈密顿密度（模局部差分项）须属于键算符 w_j±w_{j+1} 的交换子代数；并证明此类哈密顿量及其守恒荷可由 Yang-Baxter 三元的单值矩阵构造，适用于任意有限局域维度、无需平移不变性或常规 Yang-Baxter 可积性。
AI.motivation: 研究一维量子系统何时具有加性守恒荷（均匀或交错单点算符和式），并试图在不依赖常规 Yang-Baxter 可积性和平移不变性的条件下，统一刻画并分类这类哈密顿量。
AI.method: 以键算符 w_j±w_{j+1} 的交换子（local commutant）为核心，建立守恒条件为键哈密顿密度（模对周期边界求和的局域差分项）属于该交换子；再由这些局域交换子出发，用标量 Yang-Baxter 三元中的正则与非正则成员构造单值矩阵，从而生成哈密顿量及其守恒荷。
AI.result: 证明该条件对周期链 L≥3（交错情形需偶长度）为充要条件；构造与表示无关，适用于任意有限局域维度，且各键相互作用可独立选取，覆盖所有具有指定加性对称性的哈密顿量，无需普通 Yang-Baxter 可积性；用 spin-1/2 与 spin-1 系统举例，并讨论与双交换子定理的关系。
AI.conclusion: 对单点生成元 w 及其键交换子进行分类，可为具有加性守恒荷的此类哈密顿量提供一条分类路径。

title: Nonlocal Josephson coupling and current redistribution in a large-area graphene multiterminal Josephson junction
summary: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. We reproduce the NDLR response with a network containing the interplay between two distinct forms of nonlocality: nonlocal Josephson coupling, which determines the switching sequence of the superconducting network, and nonlocal normal-state conductance, which redistributes current after different regions switch. Our results highlight the potential of the emergent NDLR for characterizing superconductor--semiconductor hybrid systems and for nonlinear circuits. Further, this Josephson Hall bar geometry provides a platform for exploring the interplay between mesoscopic superconductivity and many-body ground states in graphene-based heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 在石墨烯霍尔条中实现多端约瑟夫森网络，观测到近开关电流处的负微分纵向电阻（NDLR），由非局域约瑟夫森耦合与非局域正常态电导的相互作用解释。
AI.motivation: 传统多端约瑟夫森结中，超导输运常由相邻引线间的局域耦合主导，掩盖了超越简单连通性的物理现象，因此需要实现具有显著非局域耦合的多端器件。
AI.method: 采用微米尺度石墨烯霍尔条几何构建多端约瑟夫森网络，实现远距离终端间的强非局域耦合；通过四探针与两端测量对比，并建立包含非局域约瑟夫森耦合（决定开关序列）和非局域正常态电导（重新分配电流）的网络模型进行复现。
AI.result: 在四探针响应中于开关电流附近观测到显著的负微分纵向电阻（NDLR），而两端测量中无此特征；网络模型成功复现了该NDLR响应。
AI.conclusion: NDLR可作为一种表征超导-半导体混合系统的探针，并可用于非线性电路；该约瑟夫森霍尔条几何为研究石墨烯异质结构中介观超导与多体基态相互作用提供了平台。

title: MolP2SBench: Do LLMs Really Reason from Molecular Properties to Structure?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in molecular discovery and structure elucidation, where decisions depend on physical observations. Existing evaluations primarily focus on end-to-end molecular reconstruction, where correct predictions do not necessarily indicate reliance on the supplied properties. We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark for molecular property-to-structure (P2S) reasoning in LLMs. Each task presents a masked molecular scaffold with given properties and asks the model to select the missing structure from plausible candidates. We shuffle or replace properties to test reliance on correct property-structure pairing and responsiveness to counterfactual property changes. A channel-wise leaderboard uses Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR), giving equal weight to source and counterfactual recovery. Evaluating seven models, we find that LLMs can use physical properties for structure prediction, but performance varies substantially across property types. Higher accuracy with a property does not necessarily imply greater responsiveness to it: a model may benefit more from $^1$H NMR than from $^{13}$C NMR, yet be less likely to change its prediction when the $^1$H data is replaced. LLM performance also need not reflect the relative difficulty of these properties for human chemists. Although UV-Vis spectra provide less direct structural information than NMR spectra, Astra achieves higher accuracy with UV-Vis data than with NMR peaks. MolP2SBench supports studying how LLMs extract and use physical-property information, revealing patterns that may differ from conventional chemical intuition and providing a foundation for more reliably property-grounded models for molecular and quantum-chemical inference. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/MolP2SBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 MolP2SBench 基准，评估LLM能否真正依赖物理性质进行分子结构推理，而非仅做端到端重构。
AI.motivation: 现有评估聚焦端到端分子重构，正确预测不代表模型真正依赖所给物理性质，需新基准测试性质-结构的真实依赖关系。
AI.method: 设计掩码分子骨架加给定性质，让模型从候选结构中选择缺失部分；通过打乱/替换性质测试对正确性质-结构配对的依赖及对反事实性质变化的响应。提出分通道排行榜，用 Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR) 均衡来源与反事实恢复指标，评估七个模型。
AI.result: LLM 能利用物理性质预测结构，但跨性质类型差异大；高准确率不一定意味着更强响应性（如对¹H NMR 受益更多却对替换更不敏感）；表现与人类化学家的难度直觉不一致（如UV-Vis信息更少但Astra准确率更高）。
AI.conclusion: MolP2SBench 揭示LLM提取和使用物理性质信息的模式可能与化学直觉不同，为更可靠的性质接地模型奠定基础。

title: Realizing Two-Dimensional Altermagnets with 100% Spin Polarization along the [110] Direction in Ambidentate-Ligand Based Square Organometallic Lattices
summary: Altermagnetism, as a novel magnetic paradigm, not only possesses a zero net magnetic moment, but also exhibits a substantial nonrelativistic spin-splitting effect. Currently, developing a simple and experimentally feasible method for designing altermagnets is eagerly pursued. Moreover, achieving 100% spin polarization along certain directions in valence or conduction bands for altermagnets remains challenging. To address these issues, based on a tight-binding model, we propose a viable chemical strategy for constructing organometallic altermagnets by using ambidentate ligands. Furthermore, in these organometallic altermagnets, direction-dependent 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in band edges can be induced via the coexistence of altermagnetically spin-split dispersive and flat bands, where the flat band suppresses electron transport in one spin channel and the dispersive band enables conduction in the other spin channel. Then, via first-principles calculations, a screening of 90 two-dimensional ambidentate-ligand based square organometallic lattices leads to the identification of three altermagnetic materials, namely Fe(taz)2Cl2 (taz = 1,2,4- triazine), Co(app)2Cl2, and Fe(app)2Cl2 (app = 1,4-azaphosphinine), all of which possess 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in valence bands, as well as notable piezomagnetic behavior. This study paves the way for achieving direction-dependent fully spin-polarization in altermagnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 提出用双齿配体构建有机金属交替磁体的化学策略，并实现[110]方向价带100%自旋极化。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体兼具零净磁矩与非相对论自旋劈裂，但缺乏简单可行的设计方法，且沿特定方向实现100%自旋极化仍具挑战。
AI.method: 基于紧束缚模型提出双齿配体化学策略，并结合第一性原理计算筛选90种二维方形有机金属晶格。
AI.result: 识别出三种交替磁材料：Fe(taz)2Cl2、Co(app)2Cl2和Fe(app)2Cl2，均在[110]方向价带具100%自旋极化及显著压磁行为；其机制源于交替磁自旋劈裂的色散带与平带共存。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为交替磁材料中实现方向依赖的完全自旋极化开辟了道路。

title: Alter-excitons in Altermagnets: Symmetry, Splitting and Dispersion
summary: Magnetism provides a fertile platform for discovering emergent quantum phenomena governed by symmetry. Recent developments of spin-space-group (SSG) theory have revealed altermagnets as a distinct class of nonrelativistic collinear magnets with unconventional spin-dependent electronic structures. Here, we demonstrate that altermagnetic symmetry imposes fundamentally different constraints on electronic and excitonic excitations. Although the quasiparticle and two-body Hamiltonians possess identical SSG symmetries, we find that symmetry-protected degeneracies present in the electronic band structure can be intrinsically lifted in the exciton spectrum at specific momenta. This splitting arises solely from the many-body nature of excitons and does not require spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order. Combining symmetry analysis with many-body perturbation theory, we predict a novel class of spin-split excitonic quasiparticles, termed alter-excitons, and reveal their characteristic dispersions in altermagnetic systems. Our results establish excitons as a sensitive probe of hidden spin-space symmetries and uncover a new route toward symmetry-engineered many-body phenomena in collinear magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文将交错磁（altermagnet）对称性分析从单粒子电子结构扩展到激子，发现"alter-exciton"——一种无需自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序、仅由多体效应导致的动量分辨自旋劈裂激子，建立激子作为探测隐藏自旋空间对称性的灵敏探针。
AI.motivation: 自旋空间群（SSG）理论已揭示交错磁为具非常规自旋依赖电子结构的非相对论共线磁体，但此前研究主要聚焦单粒子能带；激子作为两体激发在交错磁对称性下的行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 结合对称性分析与多体微扰理论，比较准粒子与两体哈密顿量在相同SSG对称性下的表现，分析激子谱中对称性保护的简并如何被打破。
AI.result: 尽管准粒子与两体哈密顿量具有相同的SSG对称性，电子能带中受对称性保护的简并可在激子谱中特定动量处被内禀解除。该劈裂纯粹源于激子的多体本质，无需自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序。预测了被称为alter-exciton的新型自旋劈裂激子准粒子及其特征色散。
AI.conclusion: 激子是探测隐藏自旋空间对称性的灵敏探针，为共线磁体中对称性工程化的多体现象开辟了新途径。

title: Odd-Parity Crystalline Electric Field and Multipoles in Icosahedral Quasicrystal and Approximant: Magnetic Toroidal and Electric Dipoles in Ce-Based Systems
summary: Quasicrystals (QCs) lack periodic arrangement of atoms but possess unique structural order distinct from periodic crystals and random systems. The electronic property is far from complete understanding. Here we have formulated not only even-parity but also odd-parity crystalline electric field (CEF) in the Ce-based icosahedral QC and approximant crystal (AC) on the basis of the point charge model. Under the odd-parity CEF due to local-inversion symmetry breaking at the Ce site, the hybrid wavefunction of 4f and 5d states at Ce is shown to give rise to the odd-parity multipoles such as electric dipole and magnetic toroidal (MT) dipole. We have found that the vortex order in the 1/1 AC where the magnetic moments on each icosahedron swirl is characterized by the cluster-type MT moment. The ferroic alignment of the cluster MT moments in the vortex order gives rise to the electro-magnetic effect. The cluster-MT moment is shown to be resonated with the MT dipole moments in each icosahedron by tuning the 4f energy level and 5d energy level so as to approach. We have revealed a noncollinear magnetic structure is stabilized in the ground state of the icosahedral QC cluster, behind which there exists underlying mechanism to prefer the ferroic interaction for the net MT dipole moments between the icosahedrons. We point out that the 4f and 5d energy levels can be made approach at the valence transition or the valence crossover, which is ubiquitous in the rare-earth based ACs and QCs.

AI.tldr: 本文基于点电荷模型构建了Ce基二十面体准晶及近似晶体中偶宇称与奇宇称晶体电场(CEF)，揭示了奇宇称CEF下4f-5d杂化产生的奇宇称多极子(电偶极、磁环偶极)，并阐明了涡旋序的团簇型磁环矩及非共线磁结构稳定机制。
AI.motivation: 准晶缺乏周期性原子排列但具有独特结构序，其电子性质理解尚不完整，尤其是Ce基二十面体准晶中晶体电场及奇宇称效应未被充分研究。
AI.method: 基于点电荷模型，构建Ce基二十面体准晶和1/1近似晶体中偶宇称与奇宇称晶体电场；考虑Ce位点局域反演对称破缺下的4f-5d杂化波函数，分析奇宇称多极子(电偶极、磁环偶极)及团簇型磁环矩。
AI.result: 发现1/1近似晶体中涡旋序(每个二十面体上磁矩旋转)由团簇型磁环矩表征；团簇磁环矩的铁性排列产生电磁效应；通过调节4f与5d能级接近可使团簇磁环矩与各二十面体内磁环偶极矩共振；二十面体准晶团簇基态稳定存在非共线磁结构，其背后机制倾向于二十面体间净磁环偶极矩的铁性相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 指出稀土基近似晶体与准晶中普遍存在的价态转变或价态交叉可使4f与5d能级接近，从而为实现上述奇宇称多极子与涡旋序提供条件。

title: Replica Transition at Measurement-Altered Ising Criticality
summary: Performing measurements on gapless quantum ground states can give rise to new universal phenomena, whose origins remain poorly understood even for the paradigmatic Ising critical point. Replica methods offer a natural framework to study such post-measurement ensembles, with the replica limit $Q\to 1$ describing physical Born-averaged observables. Here we show that, for the monitored critical Ising chain, the replicated post-measurement ensemble of states itself undergoes a phase transition precisely at the physically relevant replica limit $Q \to 1$, preventing standard replica treatments. We use boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) methods to explain the underlying mechanism of this transition. Our methods yield a perturbative analytic calculation of the universal $O(1)$ constant in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record, previously known only numerically. We also apply our tools to study measurement-averaged spin correlators, providing a unified description of the universal properties of measurement outcomes and post-measurement states in the critical Ising chain.

AI.tldr: 研究了监测临界Ising链的测量后态集合，发现复本后测量态集合在物理相关的复本极限Q→1处发生相变，用边界共形场论(BCFT)解释机制，并解析计算了测量记录Shannon熵中的普适O(1)常数。
AI.motivation: 对无能隙量子基态进行测量可产生新的普适现象，但其起源尚不清晰，即使是典型的Ising临界点也如此。复本方法是研究测量后态集合的自然框架，其中复本极限Q→1对应物理的Born平均观测量。然而标准复本处理可能失效。
AI.method: 针对监测临界Ising链，分析复本后的测量态集合；使用边界共形场论(BCFT)方法揭示该相变的底层机制；并进行微扰解析计算。
AI.result: 发现复本后测量态集合恰在物理相关的复本极限Q→1处发生相变，从而阻止标准复本处理。解析得到测量记录Shannon熵中普适O(1)常数（此前仅数值已知）。并将工具应用于测量平均自旋关联函数。
AI.conclusion: BCFT方法为临界Ising链中测量结果与测量后态的普适性质提供了统一描述。

title: Vacuum-field-mediated Landau-level reconstruction in a cavity-coupled two-dimensional electron gas
summary: We study a two-dimensional electron gas in the integer quantum Hall regime coupled to a single spatially modulated cavity mode in the static off-resonant limit. Retaining both paramagnetic and diamagnetic contributions on equal footing, we derive a gauge complete single-particle Hamiltonian in which virtual photon exchange generates a periodic kinetic renormalization and a diamagnetic scalar potential. Both terms transfer momentum by $2k_0$ and displace guiding centers by $ΔX=2k_0\ell_B^2$, forming a finite-$k_0$ momentum ladder. Diagonalizing the strip Hamiltonian, we find that the ladder reconstructs the Landau-level band structure and redistributes, rather than multiplies, the associated chiral edge states. Occupied-subspace Chern numbers remain $C_ν=ν$ for $ν=1,2,3$ throughout $0\leλ_{\mathrm{cav}}\le 0.5$, while the bulk gaps decrease without closing. Strip Kubo responses show cavity-induced displacements of the Hall-step energies; at finite width the plateau heights are noninteger and approach the integers as $L_x$ increases. The ladder is spectrally resolved at $k_0\ell_B=0.5$ and collapses at $k_0\ell_B=0.1$. These results isolate a spatially local, finite-$k_0$ momentum ladder as a clean-system mechanism by which a structured vacuum field reconstructs quantum Hall spectra and strip transport without changing the integer topology, complementary to cavity-mediated all-to-all hopping.

AI.tldr: 研究二维电子气在整数量子霍尔区与单个空间调制腔模耦合，发现虚光子交换产生动量阶梯，重构朗道能带与边缘态但保持整数拓扑。
AI.motivation: 探究结构化真空场（空间调制腔模）如何影响量子霍尔系统的能谱与输运，并厘清其与已知腔介导全局跃迁机制的差异。
AI.method: 在静态失谐极限下，同时保留顺磁与抗磁贡献，推导规范完备的单粒子哈密顿量；对角化条带哈密顿量，计算陈数、体能隙及条带Kubo响应。
AI.result: 虚光子交换产生周期性能动重整化与抗磁标量势，二者均以2k0传递动量并移动导向中心，形成有限k0动量阶梯；该阶梯重构朗道能带、重分配而非倍增手性边缘态；占据子空间陈数保持Cν=ν（ν=1,2,3），体能隙减小但不闭合；Kubo响应显示霍尔台阶能量位移，有限宽度下平台高度非整数并随Lx增大趋近整数；阶梯在k0ℓB=0.5可分辨、在0.1塌缩。
AI.conclusion: 空间局域、有限k0动量阶梯是一种纯净机制，使结构化真空场重构量子霍尔谱与条带输运而不改变整数拓扑，与腔介导的全对全跃迁互为补充。

title: The Reference Set Is Not the Answer Set: GEOM-DRUGS Is Missing Low-Energy Conformers on Its Own Energy Surface
summary:
Machine-learned conformer generators are scored on GEOM-DRUGS by proximity to a reference ensemble that standard benchmark metrics implicitly treat as ground truth. We test whether that finite set is complete on the GFN2-xTB surface used to construct it. Across five public generators, settled, low-energy structures remain outside the $0.75$\,Å reference radius after removing reflections, incorrect stereochemistry, and post-relaxation connectivity changes ($2.3$--$7.0\%$ of submitted conformers, depending on architecture). In a targeted DFT audit, $107$ of $113$ chemically screened novel/reference pairs remain outside that radius after full $ω$B97X-D3BJ re-optimization. A threshold-free complementary test needs no radius and no energy window at all: on $15.0\%$ $[8.0, 22.0]$ of molecules some generator has already found a chemically intact structure lying below the \emph{entire} released ensemble. A complementary CREST search reproduces the minimum released in
  $65$ of $69$ molecules, and in $11$ of them it reaches more than $0.5$\,kcal/mol below the complete released ensemble. Augmenting the references with conformers proposed by held-out architectures raises absolute coverage-precision for every generator tested, by $1.48$--$2.99$ points. Together, these results show that GEOM-DRUGS precision is sensitive not only to generator quality but also to incomplete reference support.

AI.tldr: 本文检验GEOM-DRUGS参考集在其GFN2-xTB势能面上是否完备。结果显示多种生成器能找到被参考集遗漏的低能构象，且互补CREST搜索能重现/超越已发布最小值，说明该基准的精度受参考集不完备性影响。
AI.motivation: GEOM-DRUGS被标准基准指标隐含当作ground truth，但该有限参考集在其构建所用势能面上可能并不完备，从而影响对构象生成器的评价。
AI.method: 在五个公开生成器上，去除镜像、错误立体化学和弛豫后连接变化，考察0.75 Å参考半径外的低能构象；进行DFT审计（ωB97X-D3BJ重优化）；设计无需半径和能量窗口的互补测试；用CREST搜索及留出架构提出的构象扩充参考集。
AI.result: 提交构象中2.3%–7.0%落在参考半径外；DFT审计中113对中有107对仍在半径外；15.0%分子（区间[8.0,22.0]）某生成器已找到低于整个发布集的化学完整结构；CREST在69个分子中的65个重现发布最小值，11个低出超过0.5 kcal/mol；用留出架构构象扩充参考后，所有生成器绝对覆盖-精度提升1.48–2.99点。
AI.conclusion: GEOM-DRUGS的精度不仅取决于生成器质量，也受参考集不完备性的影响，需扩充参考集以更公平评估。

title: Drude, Where's My Charge? End-to-End Learning of Polarizable Drude Force Fields for Polymer Electrolytes
summary: Molecular dynamics simulations of solid polymer electrolytes require force fields that are fast enough to converge ion transport over hundreds of nanoseconds, yet accurately describe the ion-polymer interactions that govern it. Fixed-charge force fields meet the first requirement but neglect electronic polarization, an effect often approximated by scaling ionic charges using empirically chosen factors. Here we present AutoDrude, a differentiable framework that parametrizes polarizable Drude force fields directly from DFT energies, forces, and dipoles, with no empirical tuning and at only 1.20 times the cost of a fixed-charge simulation. For PEO-LiTFSI, the dipole-constrained (hard-constraint) AutoDrude model reproduces the experimental ionic conductivity as accurately as the best charge-scaled model (17% versus 16% mean absolute percentage error). We compare the polarizable forcefield to fixed charge ones models by fitting a fixed charge model. Unlike the charge-scaled models tested here, however, AutoDrude also reproduces the dilute-limit cation transference number, its increase with salt concentration, and the absence of Li-TFSI contact ion pairs at low concentration. A penalty-based (soft-constraint) variant yields a closer fit to the DFT reference yet underestimates the conductivity by up to an order of magnitude, demonstrating that closer agreement with DFT training data alone does not guarantee accurate ion transport. These results indicate that although charge scaling can reproduce ionic conductivity the explicit inclusion of polarization is necessary to capture the concentration dependence of cation transport in PEO-LiTFSI.

AI.tldr: AutoDrude是一种可微框架，直接从DFT数据参数化极化Drude力场，以接近固定电荷模型的成本准确再现PEO-LiTFSI的离子传导与阳离子迁移行为。
AI.motivation: 固体聚合物电解质模拟需要兼顾计算速度与准确描述离子-聚合物相互作用的力场。固定电荷力场虽快但忽略电子极化，通常仅用经验电荷缩放近似，难以准确刻画离子输运。
AI.method: 提出AutoDrude可微框架，直接从DFT能量、力和偶极参数化极化Drude力场，无需经验调参，成本仅为固定电荷模拟的1.20倍。在PEO-LiTFSI上对比硬约束（偶极约束）与软约束（惩罚项）变体，并拟合固定电荷模型进行比较。
AI.result: 硬约束AutoDrude重现实验离子电导率（17% MAPE），与最佳电荷缩放模型（16%）相当；同时能重现稀极限阳离子迁移数、其随盐浓度增加的趋势以及低浓度下无Li-TFSI接触离子对。软约束变体更贴近DFT但电导率低估达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 电荷缩放可重现电导率，但只有显式引入极化才能捕捉PEO-LiTFSI中阳离子输运的浓度依赖性。与DFT训练数据更接近并不保证离子输运准确。

title: Energy-dependent trapping of backscattered helium during magnetron sputtering growth: A molecular dynamics study
summary: Helium incorporation during magnetron sputtering can strongly affect thin film growth and lead to the formation of gas/solid nanocomposites and nanoporous structures. Here, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are used to investigate the trapping mechanism of helium atoms (He) and the subsequent formation of He bubbles during the sputter deposition of aluminum (Al) and titanium (Ti) thin films. The simulations account for the kinetic energy distributions of sputtered metal atoms and backscattered gas species. Results indicate that He is efficiently incorporated into the growing films, leading to the formation of high-pressure, dense He bubbles, with a much higher He-to-metal atomic ratio in Ti ($\sim$ 60%) than in Al ($\sim$ 12%). More importantly, the simulations reveal a clear energy dependence of He trapping in Ti: background He atoms at thermal energies are essentially not incorporated, whereas efficient trapping starts at an incident energy of approximately 20 eV and increases up to a saturation regime near 100 eV. Simulated thermal desorption spectroscopy (TDS) further reveals distinct release mechanisms in the two investigated metals: He desorption from Al occurs at higher temperatures and is preceded by the removal of surface Al atoms, whereas He and Ti atom desorption starts continuously around 950 K, leading to a porous structure. Comparative simulations with argon (Ar) demonstrate negligible trapping even at comparable kinetic energy or momentum, showing that neither parameter alone accounts for the strong He incorporation observed in Ti. The above results are in very good agreement with what is reported in literature for low-kinetic energy He ion implantation in metal surfaces, suggesting similar insertion mechanisms. They clarify the atomistic conditions governing noble gas trapping during film growth and provide a basis for controlling He incorporation and porosity in films synthesized by magnetron sputtering.

AI.tldr: 分子动力学模拟揭示磁控溅射Al、Ti薄膜中He的捕获机制：Ti捕获率(~60%)远高于Al(~12%)，He捕获存在约20 eV起始、100 eV饱和的能量依赖性，且两种金属的释放机制不同。
AI.motivation: 磁控溅射中氦掺入会显著影响薄膜生长，导致气/固纳米复合和纳米多孔结构，但其原子尺度捕获机制尚不清楚，亟需阐明以控制He掺入与孔隙率。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学(MD)模拟，考虑溅射金属原子和背散射气体种类的动能分布，研究Al和Ti薄膜溅射沉积过程中He原子的捕获及He气泡形成；并进行模拟热脱附谱(TDS)及与Ar的对比模拟。
AI.result: He被高效掺入生长薄膜形成高压致密He气泡，Ti中He/金属原子比(~60%)远高于Al(~12%)；Ti中He捕获具能量依赖性，热能量He基本不掺入，约20 eV起高效捕获并在~100 eV附近饱和。TDS显示Al中He脱附温度较高且伴随表面Al原子移除，而Ti中He与Ti原子在~950 K连续脱附形成多孔结构。对比Ar模拟显示即使动能或动量相当其捕获也可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 结果与低动能He离子注入金属表面的文献报道高度一致，提示相似的插入机制；阐明了薄膜生长中惰性气体捕获的原子尺度条件，为控制磁控溅射薄膜中He掺入与孔隙率提供了基础。

title: X-ray absorption spectroscopic studies of oxygen-deficient double perovskite oxide NdBaCo$_2$O$_{5+δ}$ ($δ\sim 0.65$)
summary: The degree of oxygen vacancy in A-site-doped layered double perovskite oxides can lead to anion vacancy ordering, which subsequently results in distinct superstructures. We have studied oxygen deficient double perovskite oxide, NdBaCo$2$O$_{5+δ}$ ($δ\sim$ 0.65), utilising X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy complemented by multiple scattering and first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT+U). The present results establish a direct correlation between oxygen-vacancy distribution, magnetic inhomogeneity, and charge transport in layered cobaltates. Our investigations on the Co K, Ba, and Nd $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ edges suggest that the near-edge spectra, based on the number and shape of the spectral features, indicate the value of $δ$ for the compound under study lies closer to 0.75. The analysis of the Ba $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ edge spectrum confirms the +2 oxidation state for Ba ions. The Co K-edge near-edge spectra suggest the possibility of oxygen vacancies arising at the basal sites in addition to the apical sites. This is counterintuitive to the common understanding that oxygen vacancies usually occur at the apical sites, i.e., in the lanthanide (Nd) layer in these compounds. Such a distribution of oxygen vacancies naturally explains the Griffith phase and the conduction mechanism of variable range hopping observed in the compound. The vacancy distribution, when at the optimum level, can also bring about easier oxygen ion mobility and a more sensitive and faster oxygen sensor. We believe that our results will help in tailoring oxygen-ion mobility and enhancing oxygen-sensing performance.

AI.tldr: 研究NdBaCo₂O₅₊δ (δ~0.65)中用XANES结合多重散射与DFT+U计算，揭示氧空位分布与磁性不均匀、电荷输运的直接关联。
AI.motivation: A位掺杂层状双钙钛矿中氧空位程度可导致阴离子空位有序及不同超结构，需理解氧空位分布对磁性与输运的影响。
AI.method: X射线吸收近边结构(XANES)谱，结合多重散射与基于DFT+U的第一性原理计算，测量Co K、Ba及Nd L_III边。
AI.result: 近边谱特征表明δ更接近0.75；Ba L_III边确认Ba为+2价；Co K边显示除顶位外基位也可能出现氧空位，与往常认知相反。该分布解释了Griffith相与变程跳跃导电机制。
AI.conclusion: 氧空位分布处于最优水平时，可提升氧离子迁移率与氧传感器灵敏度/速度，有助于调控氧离子迁移并增强氧传感性能。

title: Robust Golden Ratio universality as a consequence of a circulant symmetry
summary: We find a robust scenario for the emergence of the Golden Ratio (GR) dynamical universality class, characterized by the dynamical exponent $z \equiv \varphi=\frac{1}{2}(1+\sqrt{5})$. Previously, its emergence required fine-tuning of system parameters. Here, the GR universality class appears generically in a wide class of Markov processes as a consequence of a global, circulant symmetry of the flux Jacobian. This symmetry leads to GR universality in systems where the total number of conservation laws is odd and larger than three. We introduce a multilane exclusion process with Bernoulli stationary measure as a minimal, parameter-free model, which features GR universality for all conserved modes, most of which are doubly degenerate. Our predictions, based on mode-coupling theory generalized to treat degenerate conserved modes, are corroborated by large-scale Monte Carlo simulations.

AI.tldr: 该文提出黄金比例(GR)动力学普适类的稳健涌现机制：在一大类马尔可夫过程中，通量雅可比矩阵的全局循环对称性可导致z=φ的GR普适类，条件是守恒律数目为大于3的奇数。作者引入一个无参数的多车道排他过程作为最小模型，并用推广的模耦合理论和大规模蒙特卡洛模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 此前GR普适类(z=φ)的涌现需要对系统参数进行精细调节，缺乏一般性机制。作者希望找到一种无需微调、在广泛系统中自然出现的GR普适类来源。
AI.method: 通过分析马尔可夫过程通量雅可比矩阵的全局循环(circulant)对称性，论证该对称性在守恒律数目为大于3的奇数时普遍导致GR普适类。引入多车道排他过程(带Bernoulli稳态测度)作为无参数最小模型，并使用推广到处理简并守恒模的模耦合理论进行分析，辅以大规模蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.result: GR普适类在该类过程中普遍出现，并在所有守恒模上表现，其中多数模是双重简并的。理论预测与大规模蒙特卡洛模拟结果一致。
AI.conclusion: GR动力学普适类可由循环对称性稳健产生，无需参数微调，为在更广系统中寻找GR普适类提供了新途径。

title: Parity-Anomalous Hall Response of Chiral Lifshitz Fermions
summary: The parity anomaly of a single massless Dirac fermion is manifested as a half-quantized Hall response once the required parity-breaking regularization is supplied. We study the corresponding response for two-dimensional chiral Lifshitz fermions. For a node with low-energy coupling (qx +iqy)^N, the Fermi-loop winding number W = N gives an anomalous Hall response σxy^anom = (W/2)e^2/h. We examine this mechanism in chiral multilayer Haldane models tuned to a valley-selective critical line, where a single gapless chiral Lifshitz fermion remains at the K valley. For the AB, ABC, and ABCA stacks, the projected pseudospin textures give W = 2, 3, 4, while Kubo calculations yield σxy = (1, 3/2, 2)e^2/h; integrated equilibrium boundary currents reproduce the same W/2 sequence. Six-terminal simulations with dephasing further show that the Hall conductivity is quantized at W/2 while the longitudinal conductivity remains finite. These results identify gapless chiral Lifshitz fermions as a higher-order, winding-controlled generalization of the parity-anomalous Hall response, distinct from a quantum anomalous Hall insulating state even when W/2 is an integer.

AI.tldr: 研究手性Lifshitz费米子的宇称反常霍尔响应，发现其霍尔电导为W/2·e²/h，W为费米环缠绕数。
AI.motivation: 将单质Dirac费米子的宇称反常半量子化霍尔响应推广到二维手性Lifshitz费米子，探索更高阶、由缠绕数控制的异常霍尔机制。
AI.method: 分析低能耦合(qx+iqy)^N的节点理论给出W=N；构建手性多层Haldane模型（AB、ABC、ABCA堆叠）调至谷选择性临界线，用投影赝自旋织构、Kubo计算及平衡边界电流进行验证，并做六端退相干模拟。
AI.result: AB、ABC、ABCA堆叠的缠绕数W分别为2、3、4，Kubo计算得σxy=(1,3/2,2)e²/h，边界电流重现W/2序列；六端模拟显示霍尔电导量子化为W/2，纵向电导保持有限。
AI.conclusion: 无隙手性Lifshitz费米子构成宇称反常霍尔响应的更高阶、缠绕数控制推广，即使W/2为整数也不同于量子反常霍尔绝缘态。

title: Predictive Synthesis of MOFs and COFs
summary: Predictive synthesis concerns the prospective modeling of how a targeted structure can be realized. The synthesis of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) and covalent organic frameworks (COFs) intrinsically involves a multidimensional space of interdependent variables, posing a challenge for bench chemists to parameterize and predict. In this Perspective, we discuss the evolution from chemical-intuition-driven experimentation toward the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in the laboratory. By virtue of prior knowledge, uncertainty, and experimental failure in determining what should be attempted next, we envision predictive synthesis progressing from static recipe recommendation toward real-time control and transferable principles of framework formation. In this context, the significance lies in transforming trial-and-error practice into a means of measurable chemical reasoning, thereby accelerating crystalline materials discovery and advancing synthetic chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文展望MOF/COF的预测性合成，主张从化学直觉驱动转向AI/ML融合，由静态配方推荐迈向实时控制与可迁移的框架形成原理。
AI.motivation: MOF与COF合成涉及多维、相互依赖的变量空间，难以参数化与预测，传统试错实验效率低，亟需新的合成范式。
AI.method: 这是一篇Perspective，通过讨论从化学直觉驱动的实验向实验室中AI与ML集成的演进，并利用先验知识、不确定性与实验失败来指导下一步尝试。
AI.result: 提出预测性合成的发展路径：从静态配方推荐逐步走向实时控制，并提炼可迁移的框架形成原理。
AI.conclusion: 其意义在于将试错实践转化为可度量的化学推理，从而加速晶态材料发现并推动合成化学发展。

title: Room-temperature ferroelectric p-wave magnet
summary: P -wave magnets exhibit odd-parity spin polarization in momentum space while retaining zero net magnetization, offering a promising route toward nonrelativistic spintronics. Previously reported p-wave magnets based on combined time-reversal and lattice-translation symmetry, Tt, have thus far exhibited ordering temperatures below the liquid-nitrogen range. Here, we demonstrate a distinct route to a pristine p-wave magnetism that does not require T t symmetry, and instead is based on incommensurate spin-spiral order. Specifically, the cycloidal magnetic structure of the multiferroic BiFeO3 (BFO) intrinsically realizes p-wave magnetism coexisting with ferroelectric polarization at room temperature. Combining symmetry analysis, density-functional-theory calculations, and circular photogalvanic-effect (CPGE) measurements, we find a large nonrelativistic spin splitting of approximately 100 meV associated with the cycloidal order. The resulting p-wave spin polarization gives rise to a characteristic CPGE response whose sign can be reversibly switched by electrically controlling the cycloid chirality. Our results establish ferroelectric BiFeO3 as a room-temperature platform for electrically switchable p-wave magnetism and provide a route toward voltage-controlled spintronic devices based on parity-breaking magnetic order.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需Tt对称性的p波磁性新机制，基于BiFeO3的摆线自旋螺旋序，在室温下实现与铁电极化共存的p波磁性，并可通过电场切换手性。
AI.motivation: 已报道的p波磁体依赖时间反演与晶格平移组合对称性（Tt），其有序温度低于液氮温区，限制了室温应用。因此需要寻找不依赖Tt、可在室温实现的p波磁性平台。
AI.method: 结合对称性分析、密度泛函理论计算与圆光电流效应（CPGE）测量，研究多铁材料BiFeO3的摆线磁结构。
AI.result: 在BFO的摆线序中观测到约100 meV的大非相对论自旋劈裂；p波自旋极化产生特征CPGE响应，其符号可通过电控摆线手性可逆切换。
AI.conclusion: BiFeO3被确立为室温、电可切换的p波磁性平台，为基于宇称破缺磁序的压控自旋电子器件提供新路径。

title: Physical-state supervision for design-only Gaussian process surrogates of implosion simulations
comment: 30 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23253596; code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23255040
summary: Physical diagnostics recorded during simulation can organize a sharply varying response, but using them as surrogate inputs normally requires another calculation at prediction. We construct a physical-state-supervised Gaussian process surrogate that learns these diagnostics from design variables. Cross-fitted state estimates augment a retained design representation; a global Gaussian process and an optional soft mixture of response-band experts use identical inputs. On a database of 1,987 paired one-dimensional implosions, learned burn-weighted states from calculations without alpha-particle heating reduce mean squared log-response error by 60.25% and 52.98% for the global predictor on random holdout and design-space extrapolation. Random-projection and shuffled-state supervision do not reproduce these gains. For CH, matched-input comparisons show that experts help at smaller training budgets but contribute little at 1,000 designs with this representation. A thermal-feedback benchmark validates the complete learned-state procedure, while 3,000 newly calculated Be/Cocktail designs expose weaker extrapolation gains and cases where experts degrade accuracy. A conditional state-error bound separates encoding sensitivity from routing effects. An open Python implementation reproduces the archived predictions and is released with the data, per-design results, and measured costs. Physical-state supervision is thus a useful representation for finite-data surrogates, whereas expert specialization should be selected by validation.

AI.tldr: 提出物理状态监督的高斯过程代理模型，从设计变量学习诊断量，提升有限数据下代理精度。
AI.motivation: 仿真诊断响应变化剧烈，直接用作代理输入需预测时额外计算，故希望学习这些物理诊断作为监督表示。
AI.method: 用交叉拟合的状态估计增强保留的设计表示；训练全局高斯过程及可选响应带专家软混合，输入相同。用1,987个一维内爆数据对比随机投影、打乱状态等监督。
AI.result: 学习燃烧加权状态使全局预测器在随机留出和设计空间外推上MSE(log响应)降低60.25%和52.98%；专家在小训练预算有帮助但1,000设计时贡献小；3,000个新Be/Cocktail设计外推增益较弱且专家有时降低精度。
AI.conclusion: 物理状态监督是有限数据代理的有效表示，专家特化应由验证选择。

title: Interplay of disorder and spin liquid physics in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet YbZn2GaO5
summary: YbZn2GaO5 has recently emerged as a structurally ideal triangular-lattice antiferromagnet and a promising candidate for hosting a U(1) Dirac quantum spin-liquid (QSL) ground state. However, signatures of broadened crystal electric field (CEF) excitations have raised questions about potential site disorder and its impact on the intrinsic spin dynamics. In this study, we employ 71Ga nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and muon spin relaxation (muSR) to microscopically probe both the structural and magnetic properties of YbZn2GaO5. NMR spectra reveal two inequivalent 71Ga sites and a broad distribution of quadrupolar frequencies, providing clear evidence of Ga$^{3+}$/Zn$^{2+}$ site mixing and local CEF randomness. The NMR spin-lattice relaxation rate exhibits, down to 1.3~K, a power-law temperature dependence, consistent with persisting spin dynamics below the exchange energy scale in a frustrated magnet. Complementary muSR measurements further show that the spin dynamics persist down to 30mK, with no signs of spin freezing. Together, these results establish that YbZn2GaO5 presents substantial structural disorder, while the persistence of dynamic spin fluctuations down to the lowest temperatures may indicate the survival of QSL-like excitations despite such disorder.

AI.tldr: 通过71Ga NMR与μSR对YbZn2GaO5的微观研究揭示存在Ga/Zn位点混合与CEF无序，但自旋动力学在极低温仍持续、无冻结迹象。
AI.motivation: YbZn2GaO5被认为是结构理想的三角晶格反铁磁体及U(1) Dirac量子自旋液体候选，但CEF激发展宽暗示可能存在位点无序，其对本征自旋动力学的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用71Ga核磁共振（NMR）与μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）微观探测YbZn2GaO5的结构与磁性质。
AI.result: NMR谱显示两个不等价71Ga位点及四极频率的宽分布，证实Ga3+/Zn2+位点混合与局域CEF随机性；自旋-晶格弛豫率在低至1.3 K呈幂律温度依赖；μSR表明自旋动力学持续至30 mK且无自旋冻结。
AI.conclusion: YbZn2GaO5存在显著结构无序，但动态自旋涨落在最低温仍持续，可能表明即使有此无序，QSL类激发仍可存活。

title: Orbital transfer reveals material-selective structure in Rydberg excitons
